data.name: Necrocyte
data.detailed_description:
Necrocyte is a stylized open-world zombie survival game.

The end has already begun.

In this brutal world overrun by the undead, every day could be your last. You must explore vast and dangerous environments, scavenge for resources, and fight against relentless waves of the infected.

In Necrocyte, survival is not just about combat — it’s about constantly adapting to the environment.

Hordes of zombies, mutated elites, and deadly bosses will continuously threaten your survival. You will need to gather resources, take on quests from survivor camps, and explore abandoned locations to obtain valuable loot. Build your own shelter using a modular construction system, grow crops to sustain yourself, and strengthen your character through a deep progression system.

As you grow stronger, you will unlock new skills, weapons, vehicles, and crafting recipes.

Key Features:

  • Open World Exploration
    Explore a large stylized open world featuring survivor camps, factories, farms, abandoned towns, wilderness areas, and various dangerous points of interest (POIs).

  • Dynamic Day-Night & Weather System
    Experience extreme weather conditions such as heavy rain, snowstorms, and sandstorms. Changes in time and weather will affect your body temperature and provide various buffs and debuffs.

  • Deep Survival Mechanics
    A relatively hardcore survival system where various buffs, enhancements, and diseases impact gameplay, offering both challenges and strategic depth.

  • Modular Building System
    Build your base freely using foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs, door frames, and doors. All structures are destructible and can provide warmth and shelter in harsh weather, while serving as your self-sustained refuge.

  • Farming System
    Grow crops such as pumpkins, cabbage, peppers, and herbs to ensure long-term survival.

  • Character Progression
    Level up to unlock and enhance a wide range of survival and utility skills, including stamina, immunity, willpower, physique, hunting, swimming, gathering, and driving.

    In combat, improve proficiency with melee weapons (knives, axes, hammers, spears, bats, etc.) and ranged weapons (pistols, shotguns, sniper rifles, assault rifles, etc.). Unlock abilities such as heavy attacks, smoother attack animations, increased critical hit chance, reduced recoil, improved aiming stability, and faster reloading to significantly enhance combat effectiveness.

  • Satisfying Combat System
    Featuring over 50 weapons, the combat system is carefully tuned to deliver impactful feedback and fluid pacing, making every encounter intense and rewarding.

  • Diverse Enemies & Bosses
    Face more than 30 types of enemies, including zombies, animals, and mutated creatures, along with powerful bosses—each offering unique challenges.

  • Quest & Trader System
    Multiple survivor camps are scattered across the world. Meet a variety of NPCs with distinct personalities, accept their quests, earn rewards, and gradually uncover the story.

  • Vehicles & Driving
    A variety of vehicles are available in the game. Acquire them through quests, exploration, or unlocking recipes, and improve your driving skills to enhance mobility and control.

More content will be revealed in future updates.

data.short_description: Necrocyte is a stylized open-world zombie survival game. In a world overrun by the Zombies, survival is your only goal. Explore, fight, and endure as you face relentless horrors in a brutal, unforgiving landscape. The infected are everywhere — they will hunt you down without mercy.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
